Use absolute assignment-root output paths for every fetch, never rely on a prior tool call's cd. Preserve per-fetch stdout/stderr/exit from the first attempt. - Coordinator initial blob downloads checked success but omitted persistent per-file stderr/exit receipts. Corrected separate refetch receipts establish byte-identical source. Preserve originals and disclose this rather than retroactively claim complete first-fetch retention.

These corrections are recorded in this assignment and the reviewer follow-up instruction. No native persistent memory was edited. No tool bug is established, no additional investigation is needed, and no unresolved evidence/independence gap blocks the source-only report.
comment:
No actionable defect found in the source review at `702530322ada`.

**Verified (source inspection):** The added Apple-name bindings retain the existing `Lid Switch` pair, use the same handlers, and preserve `locked = true`. Omarchy passes the key string unchanged to `hl.bind`; the inspected Hyprland v0.56.2 parser preserves the Apple name and its switch-event matcher compares it exactly.

| Switch name | Base | PR |
|---|---|---|
| `Lid Switch` | Close/open handlers registered | Unchanged |
| `Apple SMC power/lid events` | No matching pair | Same close/open handlers registered |

This fixes the registration gap, not the complete Apple lid-handling path: `omarchy-hw-laptop-closed` still relies on `/proc/acpi`, so the separate non-ACPI lid-state fix remains necessary for the described Asahi setup.

---
